import sys
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'sales_data.xlsx'
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(path)
ws = wb.active
print("Sheet:", ws.title, "max_row:", ws.max_row, "max_col:", ws.max_column)

headers = {}
for cell in ws[1]:
    if cell.value is not None:
        headers[cell.column_letter] = str(cell.value).strip()
print("Headers:", headers)

profit_col = None
rev_col = None
for col, name in headers.items():
    low = name.lower()
    if profit_col is None and 'profit' in low:
        profit_col = col
    if rev_col is None and ('revenue' in low or 'sales' in low):
        rev_col = col

if profit_col is None or rev_col is None:
    print("Name matching failed; falling back to last two data columns")
    cols = list(headers.keys())
    if len(cols) >= 2:
        rev_col, profit_col = cols[-2], cols[-1]
    else:
        raise SystemExit("Not enough columns to compute profit margin")

new_col = get_column_letter(ws.max_column + 1)
header_cell = ws[f"{new_col}1"]
header_cell.value = "Profit Margin %"
header_cell.font = Font(bold=True)

for r in range(2, ws.max_row + 1):
    c = ws[f"{new_col}{r}"]
    c.value = f'=IFERROR({profit_col}{r}/{rev_col}{r},"")'
    c.number_format = '0.0%'

wb.save(path)
print(f"Added column {new_col} 'Profit Margin %' using profit={profit_col}, revenue={rev_col}")
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=min(ws.max_row, 6)):
    print([c.coordinate for c in row], [c.value for c in row])

import sys, os, subprocess, shutil, zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

MAIN = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
PKG_REL = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships'
DOC_REL = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'
ET.register_namespace('', MAIN)

path = os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1])

z = zipfile.ZipFile(path)
bad = z.testzip()
print('zip integrity:', 'OK' if bad is None else 'BAD')

allok = True
for n in z.namelist():
    if n.endswith('.xml') or n.endswith('.rels'):
        try:
            ET.fromstring(z.read(n))
        except Exception as e:
            allok = False
            print('XML error in', n, e)
print('all XML parts well-formed:', allok)

wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
rels = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
rid2t = {r.get('Id'): r.get('Target') for r in rels if r.tag == f'{{{PKG_REL}}}Relationship'}
sheet_target = None
for sh in wb.iter(f'{{{MAIN}}}sheet'):
    t = rid2t.get(sh.get(f'{{{DOC_REL}}}id'), '')
    if not t.startswith('/'):
        t = 'xl/' + t
    sheet_target = t.lstrip('/')
    break
sx = ET.fromstring(z.read(sheet_target))
sd = sx.find(f'{{{MAIN}}}sheetData')
rows = sd.findall(f'{{{MAIN}}}row')

def txt(c):
    if c.get('t') == 'inlineStr':
        return ''.join(t.text or '' for t in c.iter(f'{{{MAIN}}}t'))
    return c.text or ''

print('header:', [txt(c) for c in rows[0].findall(f'{{{MAIN}}}c')])
data_rows = [row for row in rows if row.get('r') != '1' and row.findall(f'{{{MAIN}}}c')]
h_formulas = []
for row in rows:
    r = row.get('r')
    for c in row.findall(f'{{{MAIN}}}c'):
        if (c.get('r') or '').startswith('H'):
            f = c.find(f'{{{MAIN}}}f')
            if f is not None:
                h_formulas.append((c.get('r'), f.text))
print('data rows:', len(data_rows), '| H formula cells:', len(h_formulas))
mismatch = [x for x in h_formulas if x[1] != f'IFERROR(G{x[0][1:]}/E{x[0][1:]},"")']
print('H formulas unexpected:', mismatch if mismatch else 'none')

st = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/styles.xml'))
print('numFmts:', [(x.get('numFmtId'), x.get('formatCode')) for x in st.iter(f'{{{MAIN}}}numFmt')])
xfs = st.find(f'{{{MAIN}}}cellXfs')
print('cellXfs count attr:', xfs.get('count'), '| actual:', len(xfs.findall(f'{{{MAIN}}}xf')))
print('last xf:', xfs.findall(f'{{{MAIN}}}xf')[-1].attrib)
dim = sx.find(f'{{{MAIN}}}dimension')
print('dimension:', dim.get('ref') if dim is not None else None)
z.close()

soffice = shutil.which('soffice') or shutil.which('libreoffice') or shutil.which('soffice.bin')
print('LibreOffice binary:', soffice)
if soffice:
    outdir = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(path), 'recalc_out')
    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
    try:
        res = subprocess.run([soffice, '--headless', '--convert-to', 'xlsx', '--outdir', outdir, path],
                             capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180)
        print('convert rc:', res.returncode)
        print((res.stdout or res.stderr)[-400:])
        conv = os.path.join(outdir, os.path.basename(path))
        if os.path.exists(conv):
            shutil.move(conv, path)
            print('recalculated file written in place')
    except Exception as e:
        print('LibreOffice attempt failed:', e)
else:
    print('LibreOffice not found; cached values not computed (Excel will recalc on open)')
